page_title: MAI 2-1 BAY | Mainz v Bayern Munich 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 33305.
90+5' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+4' An attempted cross from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
90+2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Zentner intercepts the ball.
90+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.

90' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
88' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' 2 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:1.
86' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

85' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) brings his opponent down. Frank Willenborg has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
84' Paul Nebel goes off the pitch and Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz) comes on.
82' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
78' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
77' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Armindo Sieb is replaced by Karim Onisiwo (Mainz).
76' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
75' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Anthony Caci (Mainz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
74' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Konrad Laimer, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
74' Anthony Caci (Mainz) trips an opposition player and Frank Willenborg signals a foul. Bayern Munich are awarded the free kick.
72' A precise first-time shot by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender.
71' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
71' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Mainz.
70' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
69' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) receives a reproachful look from Nadiem Amiri. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
68' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
67' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
67' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul after Stefan Bell (Mainz) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to Bayern Munich.

65' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Daniel Peretz makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom right corner.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch for Eric Dier.
64' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley high over the bar from inside the box.
60' 2 - 0 Goal! Armindo Sieb plays it to Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Daniel Peretz. 2:0.
58' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) replacing Aleksandar Pavlovic.
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) will replace Raphael Guerreiro.
56' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) releases Jamal Musiala with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
54' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
53' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle after Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
53' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
49' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
46' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
45+1' Paul Nebel (Mainz) tackles a bit over-zealously and Frank Willenborg blows for a foul. Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
43' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' 1 - 0 Goal! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 1:0.
40' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.
40' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
40' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
39' The free kick is taken by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), but ball is cleared. Bayern Munich force a corner. They send men into the box.
39' Paul Nebel (Mainz) is penalised for holding. Frank Willenborg signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Bayern Munich.
37' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Zentner comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' It could have been a good chance to score! Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fails to release Michael Olise with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
35' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
32' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mainz was in an offside position.
30' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

29' Anthony Caci (Mainz) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Daniel Peretz who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
29' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
28' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
26' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
25' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Frank Willenborg stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Mainz have a free kick.
25' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
24' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle after Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Mainz are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
20' The resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared.
20' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
16' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is substituted due to injury. Bo Henriksen gives a chance to Armindo Sieb.
13' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

13' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) and his stunning dribble! He zig-zags through the defence and gets in front of the keeper. He faints to shoot and then suddenly strikes goalwards, but his effort misses the target by a whisker. Very unlucky for Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz). This could have been a legendary goal.
12' Leroy Sane picks out Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar.
10' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) plays a long ball to Michael Olise, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
8' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robin Zentner, who smothers the ball.
6' What a chance that is! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
5' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
4' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) jumps into a tackle and Frank Willenborg signals a foul. Bayern Munich earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
1' Anthony Caci (Mainz) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Mainz will take the kick-off.
Frank Willenborg will supervise the game today.
